capabilities: Create one canonical Markdown note per Zotero item
Regenerate collection index notes linking to paper notes
Migrate Zotero native notes into protected Markdown blocks
Render Pandoc-style citations as APA citations and a References block
Open Zotero items and PDF attachments via commands and context menus
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installed via BRAT from GitHub Releases rather than the community plugin store.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to mirror a Zotero library's items, collections, and notes as local Markdown files.

relations.evidence: It is designed to work with the companion Zotero plugin, Local Zotero Bridge.

summary: Zotero integration that syncs collection structure, paper metadata, and native notes into local Markdown notes in the vault.
